propositions: The shutdown drain waits only for the webhook queue to empty via queue.join(), but does not cover reconciler reviews that await review_and_vote inline outside the queue, causing them to be cancelled within shutdown_cancel_seconds (~10s) even though reviews may take minutes.

Any container stop path (manual docker compose restart, host reboot, systemd stop, autodeploy rollback) kills an in-flight reconciler review with no drain, because the drain gap is independent of the autodeploy defer logic that only protects the deployment path.

The reconcile loop must not accept new review candidates once shutdown begins, otherwise the drain timeout could be extended indefinitely by reconciler passes starting new work during the grace period.

The fix implements cooperative shutdown via reconcile.request_stop() plus a single shared shutdown_drain_seconds() deadline gated on voter.in_flight_reviews(), avoiding two independent timeout windows that would exceed the stop_grace_period budget.
The shutdown break path must record all remaining candidates in held_back to preserve the cursor low-water-mark invariant and prevent permanently unreachable patchsets.

The module-level _stop_requested flag must be cleared at the end of shutdown, after bounded cancellation, to prevent it from outliving the shutdown that set it and silently failing later reconcile_once calls in the same process.
